title: End ECall Request
description: Backs taf_ecall_End -> StopECall(), which hangs up or rejects depending on the call's current state (decided client-side, unchanged/out of scope) -- this RPC always means 'terminate this eCall'. Mirrors CallManagerServerImpl::Hangup / HangupRequest, scoped to the ecall domain per this migration's carve-out (see plan Assumption #3).
